title: Dinosaur Lab
summary: Dinosaur icons, Ice Age mammals, and prehistoric favorites become reading, sorting, number, and Top Trumps challenges.
dataNote: Body lengths and masses are rounded fossil-based estimates, not exact measurements of living animals. Mass uses metric tonnes (1,000 kg). Pterosaur wingspans are a separate measure from body length. Unsupported height and mass figures are omitted. Power is a Burrow editorial game rating, not measured strength. Reconstructions show scientific interpretations; colors and some body details are uncertain.
